method: Letter series: repeating block
steps: Rule: the block 'ZDRGB' repeats four times
Filled series: ZDRGB ZDRGB ZDRGB ZDRGB
Blanks at positions 1,5,9,13,17 = Z,B,G,R,D
check_code:
s="_DRG_ZDR_BZD_GBZ_RGB"
opts={"A":"ZBGRB","B":"ZBGRD","C":"BBGRD","D":"ZBDRD"}

    return t=="ZDRGB"*4
good=[k for k,v in opts.items() if ok(v)]
assert good==["B"]

method: Syllogism: enumerate set models
steps: Circles lie inside balls, balls inside pits; toys overlap balls
A model where toys meet balls outside circles refutes I
Pits outside toys refutes II
Neither follows
check_code:
import itertools
types=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4))  # (ball,toy,circle,pit)
def valid(m):
    if any(c and not b for b,t,c,p in m): return False
    if any(b and not p for b,t,c,p in m): return False
    if not any(b and t for b,t,c,p in m): return False
    if not any(c for b,t,c,p in m): return False
    return True
I=lambda m:any(c and t for b,t,c,p in m)
II=lambda m:all(t for b,t,c,p in m if p)
rI=rII=True
for r in range(1,5):
    for m in itertools.combinations(types,r):
        if valid(m):
            rI&=I(m); rII&=II(m)
res=(rI,rII)
opts={"A":(False,True),"B":(False,False),"C":(True,False),"D":(True,True)}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==res]==["B"]
